display.title: Episode 421: The Mystery of Toras Emes, Chapter 2 (Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan)
display.summary_short: Between Purim and Pesach: the matzah of emunah and healing, stretching the word Echad, and the conclusion of The Mystery of Toras Emes.
display.summary_long: Broadcast between Purim and Pesach 5750. Uncle Yossi teaches that every Yom Tov gives strength for the whole year: Purim gave us the mesiras nefesh of Mordechai and Esther, and Pesach gives a full year's supply of emunah through the Seder matzah, which the Arizal calls the food of faith and the food of healing. He announces how to visit a matzah bakery and urges families to buy shmurah matzah early. After the Hakochainik march, Mitzvah Time plays a phone call in which a seventh-grade girl explains why davening is like a telephone call, and she leads the Shema. Everyone gives tzedakah, and Mitzvah Time teaches that stretching the word Echad, while thinking that Hashem rules above, below and in all four directions, brings long life. Story time concludes The Mystery of Toras Emes: the shammes is talked into preparing an empty Sefer Torah to greet the king, but a dream warns the rabbi, and the officer's plot turns against him, just like Haman's. The show closes with advice on choosing a Jewish summer camp, Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan, the month of miracles, and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Every Yom Tov gives us strength for the whole year; the matzah of Pesach fills us with emunah, and Hashem protects His people and His Torah.
